message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a four-quadrant grid layout. The top section contains the word "TEMPO" in large red letters across a gold and white background. 

The top-left quadrant shows a person in a light-colored shirt with their head down, shielding their face with both hands. The top-right quadrant depicts a man wearing round glasses and a dark jacket, resting his chin on his hand with a pensive expression. The bottom-left quadrant shows a man in a white collared shirt, smiling with eyes closed and pointing his finger to the right. The bottom-right quadrant displays a man with glasses and a red shirt, smiling and giving a thumbs-up.

A black horizontal bar across the middle contains the white text "GUE JUAL, ANE BELI". Additional text includes "Polisi di Balik Korupsi Timah", "Orang Partai dalam Seleksi Anggota BPK", and a longer paragraph starting with "Batal mengusung Anies Baswedan". A barcode and "2-8 SEPTEMBER 2024" appear vertically on the far left edge. All figures are rendered in a stylized, hand-drawn caricature aesthetic with purple and yellow skin tones.
